products.name: Universal Print Deployment & Print-Server Retirement — Commercial
products.short_description: Move printing to Universal Print and retire your print servers — connect existing printers, share them from Entra ID, deploy by group through Intune, and print from anywhere. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Retire your print servers — deliver printers from the cloud through Universal Print

Print servers are a quiet liability: a box (or several) you patch, back up, and pray never falls over on a Monday morning, plus drivers and GPO printer mappings that only work on the corporate network. Universal Print moves printing to a Microsoft-hosted cloud service — printers are shared from Entra ID, deployed to users and devices through Intune, and reachable wherever people work — so you can decommission the print servers entirely. This solution makes that migration orderly: connect existing printers, deploy by group, then retire the servers.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Universal Print works, the connector model for non-native printers, Entra ID printer sharing, Intune-driven printer deployment, and the coexistence-then-cutover approach to retiring print servers.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Universal Print licensing, Entra ID, Intune, a connector host for existing printers, printer inventory, network/firewall reachability) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: license and enable Universal Print, install the connector and register printers, share printers in Entra ID, deploy printers to groups via Intune, validate printing on and off network, retire the old print queues/servers, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — print-environment discovery (servers/queues/drivers), Universal Print readiness and printing validation, a printer/deployment inventory report, safe remediation of failed printer deployments, and a printer-deployment group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Cloud-delivered printing for every user — printers shared from Entra ID and deployed through Intune, reachable on or off network — with the old print servers decommissioned, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • UPRT-Discovery.ps1 — discover existing print servers, queues, and drivers
    • UPRT-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix failed Universal Print printer deployments
    • UPRT-Report.ps1 — printer and Universal Print deployment inventory
    • UPRT-Set-PrinterDeploymentTargeting.ps1 — build the printer-deployment groups
    • UPRT-Validation.ps1 — Universal Print readiness checks and an optional test print

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
